answer: One defence is a stake-and-history gate at the economy inlet: before an agent can trade, it must lock a refundable deposit and build a verifiable record of completed work, so creating identities is no longer free. Anyone trying to forge a raven flock of fake agents must pay the deposit and the time cost for every single one, while honest agents reuse one established reputation. If a fake is caught double-claiming or cheating, its stake is slashed, so the attacker cost grows linearly with each Sybil while verification stays cheap.
